mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over 3 consecutive months reduces discount rates applied to future equity cash flows, increasing the present value of expected returns and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a flight to quality in equities, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment below 4.5% indicates a weakening labor market, reducing consumer spending and compressing discount rates, which drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in weakening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment below 3.5% triggers a strong labor market, increasing consumer confidence and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in strengthening periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 93.6 (as of t-1mo) signals weakening domestic demand, compressing discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in contraction periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in consumer price inflation below 223.5 (as of t-1mo) reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in deflationary periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in the S&P 500 index below 2400 (as of t-2mo) triggers a flight to quality in equities, compressing discount rates and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in stress periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the S&P 500 index below 2300 (as of t-1mo) indicates elevated equity risk premiums, compressing discount rates and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in expansion periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05), or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
